Rashi on Chullin 92a:10:1.english: With the gifts - that the Holy One, blessed be He, gave to Israel:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:10:2.hebrew: אלו הבכורים - שהכניסן לארץ טובה ומלאה פירות, ומביאין ממנה בכורים בפריחת גמר בשולם:
Rashi on Chullin 92a:10:2.english: These are the first fruits - for [God] brought them into a good land, full of fruits, and they bring first fruits from it at the budding of the completion of their ripening:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:11:1.english: Their time has arrived - to go out from here and to be fruitful and multiply:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:12:1.english: Its blossoms shot forth - The time of the blossom has arrived to sprinkle the lifeblood of Egypt:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:13:1.hebrew: ג' כוסות - בספור החלום, "וכוס פרעה" וגו':
Rashi on Chullin 92a:13:1.english: Three cups - In the recounting of the dream: "And Pharaoh's cup [was in my hand]," etc.:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:13:2.hebrew: בימי פרעה נכה - שהחריבה נבוכד נצר, דכתיב (ירמיהו מז): "לבא נבוכד נצר מלך בבל וגו'":
Rashi on Chullin 92a:13:2.english: In the days of Pharaoh Nekho - when Nebuchadnezzar destroyed it [Egypt], as it is written (Jeremiah 47): "for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to come, etc.":

Rashi on Chullin 92a:15:2.english: Is likened to a vine - [As it is written (Psalms 80:9):] "You plucked up a vine out of Egypt":

Rashi on Chullin 92a:15:3.hebrew: זמורות שבה אלו בעלי בתים - דמה הזמורה הזו מוציאה לולבין ועלים ופרי, והוא עיקר הגפן — כך בעלי בתים גומלי חסד, ומחזיקים ידי עניים, ומפזרים ממונם למלכות בשביל אחיהם, ומתקיימים על ידם:
Rashi on Chullin 92a:15:3.english: Its branches, these are the homeowners - For just as this branch produces shoots, leaves, and fruit, and it is the main part of the vine — so too the homeowners perform acts of kindness, support the poor, and expend their money for the government on behalf of their brethren, and [their brethren] are sustained through them:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:15:4.hebrew: עלין - שבגפן סובלין הרוח, ומגינים על האשכולות שלא יכם שרב ושמש ורוחות; כך עמי הארץ חורשין וזורעין וקוצרין מה שתלמידי חכמים אוכלים:
Rashi on Chullin 92a:15:4.english: Leaves - [those] on the vine endure the wind and shield the clusters so that heat, sun, and winds do not strike them; so too, the ignoramuses plow, sow, and reap what the Torah scholars eat.

Rashi on Chullin 92a:15:5.english: Tendrils - Vedilles [Old French for tendrils], which are not fit for anything:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:17:1.hebrew: ואכרה לי - הקב"ה אומר: קניתי לי ישראל בט"ו בניסן, בשביל הצדיקים:
Rashi on Chullin 92a:17:1.english: So I bought her [va'ekkereha] to me - The Holy One, Blessed be He, says: I acquired Israel for Myself on the fifteenth of Nisan for the sake of the righteous.

Rashi on Chullin 92a:17:2.hebrew: אשר כריתי לי - קניתי, כדאמרי' בפ"ק דסוטה (דף יג.) דיעקב זבנה מעשו:
Rashi on Chullin 92a:17:2.english: That I have acquired for me - I bought [it], as we say in the first chapter of Sotah (13a), that Jacob bought it from Esau:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:18:1.hebrew: צרור הכסף - בחלק (סנהדרין דף צו:) מפרשינן ליה בצדיקים; דשלחו ליה עמון ומואב לנבוכד נצר, כדשמעו לנביאים דאיתנבאו בחורבנא: "תא אחרבינהו". שלח להו: "מסתפינא מאלההון". שלחו ליה: "כי אין האיש בביתו". שלח להו: "בקריבא אתי". שלחו ליה: "הלך בדרך למרחוק". שלח להו: "איכא צדיקי דבעי רחמי". שלחו ליה: "צרור הכסף לקח בידו" — צדיקים שבהם המיתם:
Rashi on Chullin 92a:18:1.english: The bag of silver - In [chapter] Chelek (Sanhedrin 96b), we explain it [as referring] to the righteous: for Ammon and Moab sent [word] to Nebuchadnezzar when they heard the prophets prophesying about the destruction [of Jerusalem]: "Come, destroy them." He sent [back] to them: "I am afraid of their God." They sent to him: "For the man is not at home." He sent to them: "He will come soon." They sent to him: "He has gone on a distant journey." He sent to them: "There are righteous people who will pray for mercy." They sent to him: "He has taken the bag of silver with him" — the righteous among them, He has put them to death:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:19:4.english: And I took the thirty [pieces of] silver - And those righteous [individuals] were established for [all] generations in Israel:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:19:5.english: To the house of the Lord - [which is] in the Land of Israel.

Rashi on Chullin 92a:1:1.hebrew: כיון דאתיהיב רשותא - להזכיר את השם, דכבר הזכירוהו ב"קדוש" לאחר שלש תיבות של שבח:
Rashi on Chullin 92a:1:1.english: Once permission has been given - to mention [God's name], since they have already mentioned Him in "Holy [holy, holy]" after three words of praise:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:1:2.english: [It] is given - permission to mention [God's name] explicitly:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:20:1.english: And most of them - of the righteous of the Land of Israel:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:20:3.hebrew: ואומר אליהם - בנבואת זכריה כתיב גבי עובדי כוכבים: "ואקח את מקלי את נועם ואגדע אותו להפר את בריתי אשר כרתי את העמים", "ואומר אליהם" וגו':
Rashi on Chullin 92a:20:3.english: And I said to them - In the prophecy of Zechariah it is written regarding the idolaters: "And I took my staff Noam, and cut it asunder, to break my covenant that I had made with the peoples," [and then,] "And I said to them," etc.:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:20:4.hebrew: הבו שכרי - החזירו לי את הצדיקים שהייתם מקבלים עליהם שכר, "וישקלו" וגו':
Rashi on Chullin 92a:20:4.english: Give me my hire - Return to me the righteous [people] on whose account you were receiving reward; "and they weighed," etc.:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:21:1.hebrew: שלשים מצות - לא נתפרשו, ומהכא הוא דקא יליף:
Rashi on Chullin 92a:21:1.english: Thirty mitzvot - They were not specified, and it is from here that he derives [the number thirty]:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:2:1.english: So he strove with an angel - It is a verse in the Twelve [Minor Prophets]:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:2:2.hebrew: ויוכל איני יודע - על אי זה מהם הוא אומר "ויוכל", שנצח ונעשה שר: אם יעקב למלאך, והכי קאמר: "וישר יעקב אל מלאך ויוכל יעקב"; או הכי קאמר: "וישר אל יעקב מלאך" — כלומר נשתרר לעומתו המלאך — "ויוכל המלאך", ונצחו:
Rashi on Chullin 92a:2:2.english: And prevailed; I do not know - Regarding which of them does it say "and prevailed," [meaning] that he was victorious and became master: whether Jacob [became master] over the angel, and thus [the verse] means: "And Jacob strove with an angel, and Jacob prevailed"; or [whether] it means: "And an angel strove against Jacob" — that is to say, the angel asserted mastery against him — "and the angel prevailed" and defeated him:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:2:3.hebrew: כשהוא אומר כי שרית - ותוכל, הוי יעקב נצחו למלאך:
Rashi on Chullin 92a:2:3.english: When it states, "for you have striven" - [and concludes,] "and have prevailed," thus Jacob defeated the angel:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:2:4.hebrew: שרית עם אלהים - נשיא שבארץ ישראל, שסמוכים הם ונקראים "אלהים", כדכתיב: "עד האלהים יבא דבר שניהם" (שמות כב); "ועם אנשים" — ראש הגולה:
Rashi on Chullin 92a:2:4.english: You have striven with elohim - [This refers to] the Nasi in the Land of Israel, for they are ordained and are called elohim, [as it is written:] "the matter of both of them shall come before the judges [ha'elohim]" (Exodus 22); "and with men" — [this refers to] the Exilarch:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:5:1.hebrew: ובגפן - ישראל נמשלו לגפן, דכתיב "גפן ממצרים תסיע" (תהלים פ):
Rashi on Chullin 92a:5:1.english: And in the vine - Israel is compared to a vine, as it is written: "You plucked up a vine out of Egypt" (Psalms 80[:9]):

Rashi on Chullin 92a:5:2.english: Proud princes - Wealthy [people] and close to the monarchy:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:6:1.english: These three princes of the nations - [This refers to] angels:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:7:1.hebrew: עלתה נצה - אין חשוב נץ כל כך כשריגים, שהם ענפים קשים:
Rashi on Chullin 92a:7:1.english: Its blossoms shot forth - A blossom is not as important as branches, which are hard boughs:

Rashi on Chullin 92a:9:1.english: These are the young priests - who serve in the Temple:

Tosafot on Chullin 92a:1:1.hebrew: ברוך אופנים הוא דאמרי ליה - אבל קדוש אומרים שרפים, כדכתיב (ישעיהו ו): שרפים עומדים ממעל לו וגו', וכתיב בתריה: וקרא זה אל זה ואמר קדוש קדוש קדוש וכו'. ומה שאנו אומרים בתפלת יוצר "והאופנים וחיות הקדש" כו', היינו משום דחיות נמי אומרים ברוך, דעדיפי משרפים; וקרא נמי מוכח דחיות ואופנים אומרים ברוך, דבתר קרא ד"ברוך" כתיב: וקול כנפי החיות משיקות אשה אל אחותה וקול האופנים לעומתם קול רעש גדול. ובכל דוכתא משמע דהאופנים בתר חיות גרירי, דכתיב (יחזקאל א): ובלכת החיות ילכו האופנים אצלם ובהנשא החיות מעל הארץ ינשאו האופנים, וכתיב נמי: כי רוח החיה באופנים. ואם תאמר: דילפינן השתא לפירוש זה דחיות ושרפים אין הכל אחד, ובפרק אין דורשין (חגיגה דף יג:) אומר: פסוק אחד אומר שש כנפים לאחד ופסוק אחד אומר ארבע כנפים לאחד, ומאי קושיא? הא האי קרא דשש כנפים בשרפים כתיב והאי בחיות כתיב! וי"ל דמסתבר ליה שאין משונים בכנפיהם. וכה"ג פריך בפ' בא לו (יומא דף עב:): כתיב ועשית לך ארון עץ וכתיב ועשו ארון עצי שטים — אע"פ שהיה ארון אחר, מסתמא כמו שהיה זה כך היה זה. וכן בהמוכר פירות (ב"ב דף צט.) למ"ד: פניהם איש אל אחיו והכתיב ופניהם אל הבית — מכרובים של שלמה אכרובים של משה פריך, דמסתמא לא נשתנו זה מזה:
Tosafot on Chullin 92a:1:1.english: It is the ofanim who say "Blessed" - However, "Holy" is said by the seraphim, as it is written (Isaiah 6): "Seraphim stood above Him, etc.," and it is written after that: "And one called to another and said: Holy, holy, holy, etc." And as for what we say in the Yotzer prayer, "And the ofanim and the holy chayot, etc.," [this is because] the chayot also say "Blessed," since they are superior to the seraphim; and the verse also proves that [both] the chayot and the ofanim say "Blessed," for after the verse of "Blessed" it is written: "And the sound of the wings of the chayot touching one another, and the sound of the ofanim beside them, a great rushing sound." And everywhere it is implied that the ofanim follow after the chayot, as it is written (Ezekiel 1): "And when the chayot went, the ofanim went beside them, and when the chayot were lifted up from the earth, the ofanim were lifted up," and it is also written: "for the spirit of the chayah was in the ofanim." And if you say: We now learn according to this explanation that the chayot and the seraphim are not all one [and the same], yet in the chapter [entitled] Ein Dorshin (Chagigah 13b) [the Gemara] says: "One verse says 'each one had six wings' and one verse says 'each one had four wings'" — what is the difficulty? Behold, this verse of six wings is written regarding the seraphim and that [verse of four wings] is written regarding the chayot! And one can answer that it seems reasonable to [the Gemara] that they do not differ in their wings. And similarly [the Gemara] asks in the chapter [entitled] Ba Lo (Yoma 72b): It is written "And you shall make for yourself an ark of wood" and it is written "And they made an ark of acacia wood" — even though it was a different ark, presumably just as this one was, so was that one. And similarly in [the chapter entitled] HaMokher Peirot (Bava Batra 99a), according to the one who says: "[It is written] 'their faces were toward each other,' yet it is written 'and their faces were toward the House'" — [the Gemara] asks from the cherubim of Solomon against the cherubim of Moses, because presumably they did not differ from one another:
